_comment: turn-pipeline.md — an empty message paired with status:"done" is NOT a contradiction to correct. Stop and deliver are independent: stop is decided purely by pending tool calls (none here) and status (done); deliver is decided purely by whether content is non-empty (it isn't). Silence is a legitimate response whenever the model genuinely has nothing to add, regardless of what triggered the turn. Regression for a real design correction: an earlier version of this fix wrongly forced a retry here, conflating 'nothing to say' with 'something went wrong'.
